notes.title: Special Delivery Update 2.4
notes.notes:
Hi All!

We've just posted our latest update!  This patch includes additional improvements to newspaper throwing for Vive users as well as new obstacles/characters.

New Content


Construction Worker
Due to the increased vandalism throughout the neighborhood, construction crews have been deployed, beware of flying debris!


Skater Dude
Brah, like, watch out fer skater dudes crusin' down the sidewalks....maaaan.

Other Notes


improved motion control throwing for Vive users

fixed bug where in some cases newspapers in your basket would disappear if hit by another newspaper

additional cpu optimizations

menu selection icon/highlight will only trace to and appear on actual interactive menus


Thanks for playing Special Delivery and we hope you enjoy the new update!

The Meerkat Gaming Team

notes.title: Special Delivery 2.3 Update
notes.notes:
Hey Newspaper Delivery Specialists!

We've just posted our latest update that address some bugs and provides some gameplay improvements as well.

- improved newspaper throwing for vive users, better range and accuracy 
- added a pulse effect to newspaper pickups for better visibility and route planning
- during respawn, nearby traps or obstacles will be removed to prevent a "double death"
- removed first vehicle trap that comes from behind for an easier learning curve
- lowered audio level of the low health warning beep during Sunday delivery boss fights
- fixed bug where a crash was not triggered when hitting bridge wall between sections A and B

We hope you enjoy the patch, now get back to your deliveries!

notes.title: Special Delivery 2.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Special Delivery 2.2 is now available!  This update includes a major rework of our menu interaction for Oculus Touch and Vive users.  Based on user feedback the old system of grabbing and selecting options on a paper was very clunky and problematic at times when players happened to drop menus on top of one another.  So, we scrapped all of that and replaced it with a much simpler and streamline point and click system!

http://i.imgur.com/KbEr8Zl.png

In addition to the menus we made several bug fixes to our Breaking News Overtime game mode and several other optimizations throughout the game.

We hope you enjoy version 2.2 and the new menu interaction system!

notes.title: 2.1a Hotfix Release Notes
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

Last night we pushed out the Special Delivery 2.1a hotfix.  The update includes the following fixes and improvements.

Reaper Fixes

-Timer for the Reaper now pauses properly when pausing the game
-Reaper now immediately despawns and stops Reaper music when completing a level

VirZOOM

-VirZOOM bike detection is now much more flexible when starting the game, the bike can be turned on at any point during the startup titles or the control selection screen
-You can now perform a HMD reset at the control selection screen using the VirZOOM or gamepad button combo

Leaderboards

-We have added the Overtime leaderboards to the main menu, you'll find it on the chalkboard on the right wall

Tutorial Level

-There we some objects in the tutorial level that were not triggering a bike crash if you ran into them, these have been fixed
-The newspaper front page at the start of the tutorial level has been updated

Rendering

-We have updated the anti-aliasing method to Temporal AA, this should give a much cleaner look that is easier and more comfortable on the eyes

We hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Special Delivery 2.1 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Oldtown Observer Assoicates!

We've just released version 2.1 of Special Delivery!  This updates include some bug fixes as well as some new content.  See the release notes below:

2.1 Release Notes:

-fixed bike hud not showing proper coin count during Sunday Special Delivery rounds
-adjusted several newspaper pickup and health spawn points to make them easier to get
-fixed barriers and some fences in the tutorial level not triggering a bike crash
-fixed tutorial level houses not accepting a delivered paper

New Content:

Due to the constant vandalism of gravestones around the neighborhood it seems that evil spirits have become increasingly disturbed.  There have been reports of reaper sightings (AKA "Death") spotted around disturbed gravesights.  Use extreme caution if you plan to disturb graves.  However, a new rumor of "the only way to gain life is to cheat death" has been making its rounds.

notes.title: Release 2.0 is now available! Includes VirZOOM and gamepad support!
notes.notes:
Extra! Extra! Special Delivery just delivered a big update! 

http://i.imgur.com/uOLEbDg.png

Release 2.0 is now available! We’ve been listening to your feedback and we’ve managed to squeeze in several of your suggestions into this release, our first major update. 

GDC 2017 Sale!

To celebrate GDC 2017 and the launch of our official VirZOOM support, Special Delivery is currently 10% off! As an added bonus, get $75 off the purchase of a VirZOOM bike using promo code MEERKATVZ

http://i.imgur.com/2DFtVvS.png

If you’re one of the fortunate attendees at GDC this week, be sure to stop by the VirZOOM booth #2432 in the South Hall to demo Special Delivery and learn more about the VirZOOM bike. 

Controls! 

VirZOOM Support

Since launch, we’ve been worked closely with the talented team at VirZOOM to be the first Unreal Engine game to support the VirZOOM bike. We’re thrilled with the new level of immersion there bike has added to the game. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZpVlwmUpDw0

Pedal your bike through the neighborhood as you lean left and right to avoid obstacles and traps. Use the built in handlebar controls with gaze based aiming to throw the papers or further immerse yourself by using one of the motion controllers to grab and throw the papers. 

http://i.imgur.com/BmQLLZE.png

Gamepad Support

No motion controls? No problem! We’ve removed the requirement and added in full support for gamepad users. (VR headset is still required).

http://i.imgur.com/jlsUPjH.png

Lean to Steer 

By popular request, we’ve added a new steering option to the game. Simply lean left or right to steer the bike around the neighborhood. This control option is standard for gamepad & VirZOOM users and optional when playing with motion controllers. 

http://i.imgur.com/T7zY3ns.png

Tutorial Level

In addition to the new interactive instruction booklet, we’ve also added a tutorial level. Take a ride down a quiet country road as you learn all the game controls. 

http://i.imgur.com/Y8EaDPm.png

Overtime Mini-Game

A new mini-game has been added called Overtime with the objective of delivering for both the Oldtown Observer (blue mailboxes) and the Daily Inquisitor (red mailboxes) . The first level is unlocked after the completion of Week #1 with remaining levels unlocked after completing weeks 2-4.

http://i.imgur.com/bkysVDc.jpg 

Performance Optimizations

In addition to all the new features, we’ve also made several optimization improvements. Players should see performance gains for both CPU and GPU (more-so on the CPU side). 

What’s next?

Downtown Dash

Downtown Dash is currently in development and is expected to deliver in the next big update, Release 3.0. Players will take the seat of a bike courier as they pedal their way through the bustling downtown traffic to score as many deliveries as possible before time runs out. 

Localization

It’s our goal to bring Special Delivery to as many players around the globe as we can. Once all of the in-game text for Downtown Dash has been finalized, we’ll be localizing all of the text to as many languages as we can. 

Playstation VR

Special Delivery is coming soon to Playstation VR! Be sure to follow us on Twitter and Facebook for more information on this and other news.

http://i.imgur.com/cTg7MqHl.jpg

notes.title: Dev Blog: Release 2.0 Details
notes.notes:
Release 2.0

Delivery of our first big update, Release 2.0 is just around the corner. Here’s a look at what’s being added:

VirZoom Support!

http://virzoom.com/img/logo.png

We’re excited to announce that official support for the VirZoom bike is planned for Release 2.0! Riders will control the bike’s turns by leaning in the desired turn direction. The bike's speed will be controlled with the VirZoom pedals. 

Players will be able to choose from the from the following options to throw the papers: 
No Motion Controllers / Look-to-throw: VirZoom handlebars (both hands). Button press will throw a paper in the direction you are looking. 
One Motion Controller (left or right): One hand on VirZoom handlebars for balance/support and one motion controller to grab and throw papers.  


For more information about the VirZoom bike visit http://virzoom.com/

Additional Control Options

The new ‘lean to turn’ and ‘look to throw’ options we’re adding for the VirZoom support will also be available control options without the VirZoom bike. This includes a gamepad option for players without motion controllers.

Breaking News: Overtime

In the Overtime mini-game, players baskets will be stocked with both RED and BLUE papers with the objective of delivering the matching paper to every house on their route.

http://i.imgur.com/kK1ZHYW.jpg

Sections are unlocked by progressing in the main Breaking News game mode. 

Tutorial Level

We’re also adding a tutorial level featuring a scenic country road with billboards along the route containing helpful gameplay information.

http://i.imgur.com/I5dvzgWl.png

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0b
notes.notes:
One more small hotfix for you this morning to address another bug reported from launch.

The bike handlebars are now locked until you begin moving after you unpause the game at the start of the level.  Before, users were able to initially grab the handlebars which would then prevent them from grabbing them again after they unpaused to begin the level.  This issue will no longer occur.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0a
notes.notes:
Hello Oldtown Observer Employees!

We're happy to provide you with our first Special Delivery hotfix, version 1.0a.  This fix addresses most of the initial issues reported by the community since our launch last Friday.  Thanks to all who provided feedback!

Patch Notes:

-improved newspaper throwing power and accuracy for Vive users, this will now match the experience for Oculus Touch users

-fixed collision issues going from road to sidewalk/yards that would sometimes cause the bike to spin out

-fixed (hopefully) intermittent issue with bike popping up into the air after respawning, please let us know if you still encounter this and we will take another look

-slightly reduced kill box side for tornado

-fixed hippie protestor getting stuck after game pause

-getting killed by a tornado cow should now reward you the proper achievement
